headline: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works announces board meeting outcome
hook: Routine board meeting update from Knowledge Marine
summary: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Limited has formally reported the outcome of its board meeting held on October 21, 2026, to the stock exchange. Such procedural disclosures are standard regulatory filings required for listed companies. The filing provides baseline corporate governance updates for registered shareholders of the company. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap maritime stocks should review the official exchange filing for any specific corporate actions or resolutions passed during the meeting.
why_it_matters: Procedural filing with no immediate impact on share price

headline: Knowledge Marine sets record date for subdivision
hook: Upcoming record date for Knowledge Marine
summary: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Limited has notified the stock exchanges that November 6, 2026, will serve as the record date for its stock subdivision. This corporate action determines which shareholders are eligible for the share split. Retail investors holding the stock as of this date will see their shareholding adjusted according to the subdivision ratio.
why_it_matters: Share count and price adjust per subdivision ratio

headline: Knowledge Marine shares hit a record high following a 12% four-day rally
summary: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works saw its share price surge 12% over four days, reaching a fresh peak despite a weak broader market. This brings the stock's total gains for calendar year 2026 to 70%, significantly outperforming the BSE Sensex, which declined 16% over the same period. For retail investors, this highlights a rare outperformer in a declining market, though liquidity and valuations require caution.
why_it_matters: A rare outperformer defying a weak broader market trend
winners_losers: KMEW shareholders gain / market laggards hurt

headline: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works files AGM scrutinizer report
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. Routine compliance filings such as AGM voting results have negligible direct impact on stock prices or retail portfolios. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company can verify corporate governance resolutions were cleared.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate financial impact.
